items.title: Requests start straight away
items.body: Your message starts generating as soon as you press Enter, even when many people are using Tellr.

items.title: Type while Tellr works
items.body: On Agent decks you can write your next message while a reply is generating, then press Enter once it finishes.

items.title: Fewer failed decks at busy times
items.body: When the AI model is busy, Tellr now waits and tries again instead of stopping your request.

items.title: MCP-created decks use Agent mode
items.body: Decks created over MCP, for example from Genie One, are now Agent decks you can edit over MCP, with an instant link and preview.
